Element_Valence_State.source_text: To investigate the impact of electrode thickness on redox heterogeneity, LCO particles near the current collector from both LMLE and HMLEs were extracted using focused ion beam-SEM Fig. S7 followed by spectro-tomographic scans over the absorption K-edge of the Co element, namely TXM-XANES. This technique enables nanoscale, threedimensional spatial resolution of the local valence state of the Co element. As shown in Fig. 4a-c, the particle from the HMLE exhibits significantly higher valence inhomogeneity of Co element. Clearly, local area with high Co valence exists at the edge of the particle from HML electrode, which is further confirmed by the XANES plots in Fig. 4d obtained over the area in Fig. S839. Since the electrodes were cycled 100 times and analyzed in their delithiated states, the overall higher Co valence in the HMLE particle indicates reduced redox homogeneity.
